items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Dave Garraway walked in and I remember Dave Garraway in Chicago at Jazz Ltd.

ctx.x: Well, you also had TV exposure. You know you --

Oh, yes, the way it happened, I don't know what year this was. This is the first time that "Today's Show" on NBC, I think, I'm not sure, the first top man on that "Today" show is Dave Garraway and at one time I'm having lunch down below in Radio City, I was having lunch and Dave Garraway walked in and I remember Dave Garraway in Chicago at Jazz Ltd. He was a very good friend of Ruth and Bill Reinhardt. So Dave said to me, "What are you doing, Chief?" I said, "I don't know, I'm working here and working there." So…
I see, that's when the "Today" show was --
